newsitem.title: UK: Higgs & Hill to sell construction division.
newsitem.headline: Higgs & Hill to sell construction division.

text.p: Britain's Higgs & Hill Plc said on Tuesday it would sell its construction division to Hollandsche Beton Groep (UK) Limited, a unit of Hollandsche Beton Groep.
The sale will be on terms which attribute a value of about 28.5 million stg to the business, Higgs & Hill said. The cash proceeds to Higgs & Hill will be about 6.0 million stg.
Higgs & Hill said it also wanted to change its name into Swan Hill Group Plc as Hollandsche Beton Groep will obtain the right to use the the Higgs & Hill name.

"The proposed disposal will allow the group to concentrate on an expansion of its commercial and residential property activities where the directors believe attractive growth opportunities and returns exist," Higgs & Hill said in a statement.
The sale and name change needs approval of shareholders.
The construction division posted a pre-tax loss of 8.3 million stg in 1995 after an exceptional charge for reorganisation of 7.1 million stg.
